blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) seeks possible local accomplices of Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Meghan Markle, who was arrested in Florida over alleged possession of child sexual abuse material. Authorities are working to determine the extent of Thomas Markle’s alleged activities in the Philippines and identify individuals who may have assisted him or participated in the offenses.
